title: The YMC Filter plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Sensitive Information Exposure in all versions up to, and…
description: The YMC Filter plugin for WordPress versions up to and including 3.14.1 has a vulnerability that allows authenticated users with subscriber-level access or higher to expose sensitive information. This occurs via the 'post_status' parameter when an administrator has configured non-publish statuses in the filter grid settings. Attackers can retrieve rendered grid HTML containing details of private, draft, pending, and future posts they are not authorized to view.
